## Amazon CloudWatch Metrics

- CloudWatch provides metrics for every services in AWS
- Metric is a variable to monitor (CPUUtilization, Networkln…)
- Metrics belong to namespaces
- Dimension is an attribute of metric (instance id, environment, etc…)
- Up to 30 dimensions per metric.

## CloudWatch Metric Steams

- Continually stream CloudWatch metrics to a destination of your choice, with near-real-time delivery and low latency.

## Cloudwatch Alarms

- Used to trigger notifications for any metric
    
- Alarm States
	- Ok
	- insufficient _DATA
	- Alarm

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- Composite Alarms are monitoring the states of multiple other alarms
- AND and OR conditions

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## [[Amazon Eventbridge]] (formerly CloudWatch Events)

- A serverless task scheduler that simplifies creating, executing, and managing millions of schedules across AWS services without provisioning or managing underlying infrastructure.

[[Auto Scaling Group]]

- Allows for instances to be created or destroyed on-demand
- When load and demand is high, ASG scales out
- When demand is low, scales in
- Maintains availability of HEALTHY servers
